shell.partnerViewBlurb: Same screens as a venue owner. Billing and Stripe stay under Organizations.
shell.streamlinedOnboardingLead: Finish setup to open your dashboard

common.cityNoMatch: No match — press Enter to use "{{name}}"

trialBar.trialEndedTail: Subscribe to restore partner editing and venue play. Manage your plan and invoices in one place.
trialBar.activeTail: One location included — upgrade to add more.

partnerOnboarding.accessGrantedBody: An administrator added you to a venue, or another step completed your access. You do not need to finish this setup wizard. Taking you to your venues…
partnerOnboarding.completingBody: Creating your organization and venue. This only takes a moment.
partnerOnboarding.stepLead: Step {{step}} of {{total}} — your trial includes full features for one location for 14 days.
partnerOnboarding.multiLocationDesc: Multiple sites under one organization — roll-up analytics across locations; trial still covers one site until you subscribe.
partnerOnboarding.mapLead: Drag the pin to your venue reference point and draw the play area (geofence) — same tool as in the admin CMS.
partnerOnboarding.inviteLead: Were you invited to a team?
partnerOnboarding.errorNoPolygon: Draw a play-area polygon on the map before finishing.
partnerOnboarding.errorProfileStale: Setup saved, but your profile has not updated yet. Please wait a moment and try again.

partnerVenues.leadManagement: Open a location to manage redemptions, analytics, and your team.
partnerVenues.leadStaff: Pick a location to verify today's redemptions.
partnerVenues.leadSuperAdmin: Choose a venue in the sidebar to preview the partner experience for that location.
partnerVenues.emptySuperAdmin: No venue selected. Use “Partner dashboard context” in the sidebar, then you'll land on that location's dashboard.
partnerVenues.emptyPartner: You don't have access to any locations yet.
partnerVenues.emptyPartnerInviteHint: If you were invited to a team, accept your invite below or open the link from your email.

partnerReadOnly.trialEnded: Your trial has ended. Subscribe to make changes.
partnerReadOnly.venueLockedTrial: This location isn’t active on Cafe Social for players right now (trial ended or billing needed). Renew to unlock the venue and editing here.
partnerReadOnly.venueLockedGeneric: This venue is locked — editing is disabled.

partnerAcceptInvite.title: Accept staff invite
partnerAcceptInvite.lead: Paste the invite token from your email. You must be signed in with the same account the invite was sent to.
partnerAcceptInvite.signInFirst: Sign in first, then return to this page with your invite link.
partnerAcceptInvite.success: You're on the team at {{venueName}} as {{role}}.

partnerOrgRollup.title: Organization roll-up
partnerOrgRollup.subtitle: Combined metrics for all locations in this organization.
partnerOrgRollup.noVenues: No venues are linked to this organization yet.

partnerAnalytics.pageLead: Compare roll-up performance across all locations in an organization, or focus on a single venue. Date filters use UTC unless a venue timezone is shown.
partnerAnalytics.noAccessTitle: Analytics require owner or manager access
partnerAnalytics.noAccessBody: Your account is on the team in a staff role. Ask an owner or manager if you need organization or venue statistics.
partnerAnalytics.rangeHint: Custom from/to overrides the rolling window when both are set (UTC dates).
partnerAnalytics.openVenueDashboard: Open full venue dashboard (exports, campaigns, staff) →
partnerAnalytics.noVenuesInOrg: No venues are linked to this organization yet.
partnerAnalytics.chartRedemptionsByHour: Redemptions by hour (venue timezone when set)

roiSnapshot.title: At a glance (ROI)
roiSnapshot.footnote: Comparison uses the immediately preceding UTC window of the same length. Campaign row sums <pushSentCount>pushSentCount</pushSentCount> for sends whose <sentAt>sentAt</sentAt> falls in the period (approximate uplift vs operations).

attribution.title: Proximity & pay-per-visit attribution
attribution.lead: Nudges (100 m ring) → polygon visits → billable when nudge + enter within 15 min + 15 min dwell.
attribution.nudgeToBillable: {{percent}}% of nudges became billable visits in this period
attribution.proximityNudgesHint: Marketing pushes when players enter the arrival ring
attribution.areaRingEntersHint: Foot traffic near the venue (~100 m)

partnerSubscriptions.title: Subscriptions & billing
partnerSubscriptions.lead: Platform billing is per organization. Start your subscription inside this portal with Stripe Payment Element, then manage invoices and payment methods from Stripe customer portal.
partnerSubscriptions.stepCheckout: Use “Subscribe in this app” to complete card setup without leaving the portal (Stripe Elements).
partnerSubscriptions.stepPortal: After billing is active, use “Open Stripe customer portal” for invoices, payment methods, and plan changes.
partnerSubscriptions.stripeExplainer: Invoices, payment history, and plan changes are handled in Stripe’s secure customer portal. We do not store full card numbers in Cafe Social.
partnerSubscriptions.noOrgs: None of your venues are linked to an organization yet. Once they are, subscription and trial status will appear here.
partnerSubscriptions.subscribeHint: Requires STRIPE_PARTNER_PRICE_ID on the server and STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY for in-app pay. Optional NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PARTNER_PRICE_ID in this app overrides the price.
partnerSubscriptions.askOwner: Only owners and managers can open the billing portal for this organization.
partnerSubscriptions.billingSuccess: Payment completed — Stripe is syncing your subscription. Refresh if status does not update within a minute.
partnerSubscriptions.billingCancel: Checkout was cancelled. No charges were made.
partnerSubscriptions.subscribePpvCta: Pay per visit — add card on Stripe
partnerSubscriptions.subscribePpvHint: You pay only for attributed visits (nudge → enter → 15+ min dwell).
partnerSubscriptions.choosePlanTitle: Choose how you want to pay
partnerSubscriptions.subscriptionCardBody: Fixed monthly fee for full partner access across your locations.
partnerSubscriptions.ppvCardBody: No monthly base fee — you pay only for visits we attribute to your venue (proximity nudge, enter geofence within 15 minutes, stay 15+ minutes).
partnerSubscriptions.ppvActiveAnalyticsLink: View attributed visits and billing metrics →

addressGeocode.label: Find address
addressGeocode.hint: Search to move the map pin. You still need to draw the play-area polygon on the map.

partnerAddVenue.title: Add another location
partnerAddVenue.lead: Create a new site under {{orgName}}. Each location has its own geofence and dashboard.
partnerAddVenue.errorNameRequired: Enter a name for this location.
partnerAddVenue.errorNoPolygon: Draw the play-area polygon on the map before creating.
partnerAddVenue.trialOneSiteBody: Your trial covers one site with full features. Subscribe to add more locations under this organization.

partnerSubscriptionPay.title: Payment details
partnerSubscriptionPay.lead: Card fields are provided by Stripe (PCI scope minimized). After you pay, webhooks update your organization’s billing status.
partnerSubscriptionPay.missingOrg: Missing organization. Go back and pick an organization from Subscriptions & billing.
partnerSubscriptionPay.loadError: Could not start payment. Return to subscriptions and try again.
partnerSubscriptionPay.noPaymentStep: No card step was required — your subscription may already be active. Redirecting…
partnerSubscriptionPay.unexpectedNoSecret: Could not load the in-app payment form. Try hosted checkout from the subscriptions page or contact support.

picker.title: Act as customer
picker.label: Venue (owner experience, no billing links)
picker.hint: Partner screens respect locks and trial like the real owner. Subscription / Stripe / org billing are only on the organization detail page — not while acting here.

platform.title: Platform overview
platform.leadTail: for per-location content. To reproduce a partner experience, use
platform.leadEnd: in the sidebar. Financial work stays on the org detail page (Stripe), not in partner view.
platform.metricOrgsHint: Billing and roll-up units (single- or multi-location). Every venue should belong to one.
platform.metricVenuesHint: Physical locations; multi-location orgs share roll-up stats while each venue stays distinct.
platform.metricLockedHint: Often trial ended or billing pause — check the org.
platform.metricCanceledHint: Platform billing ended or churned for that organization.
platform.metricVenuesNoOrgHint: Assign under Organizations so billing and roll-ups apply.
platform.layoutExplainer: An organization is the same kind of entity either way: “single” vs “multi” only changes how we classify it, trial limits, and roll-up analytics when players visit different sites under one org.
platform.layoutFootnote: Player activity still attaches to the venue they are at; for multi-location orgs, analytics can also roll up across all venues in that organization.

organizations.gateBody: Organizations and billing are managed from the platform admin account.
organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.subtitle: Org → venue hierarchy: every venue should sit under an organization. Open a row for billing, Stripe, and venue membership.
organizations.filtersHint: Search is debounced. Billing status matches the API filter substring.

venues.title: Venues (CMS)
venues.subtitleSuper: Every physical location. Open a row for content, geofence, offers, perks, and staff.
venues.subtitlePartner: Locations where you are owner or manager.
venues.filterCountriesHint: Venue must match one of the selected ISO countries (empty = all).

staffRedemptions.title: Redeem code verification
staffRedemptions.leadStart: Signed in with a staff account. Match the guest's
staffRedemptions.leadEnd: after redeeming; it must appear on this UTC day list before you hand over the perk.
staffRedemptions.dashboardHint: for this venue to review moderation reports, appeals, and bans (requires MANAGER or OWNER role).
staffRedemptions.emptyDay: No redemption records for this day.

organizationDetail.peopleLead: Who created this org in self-serve onboarding and which venue owners are linked through staff roles.
organizationDetail.ownersEmpty: No owner contacts on linked venues yet.
organizationDetail.orgSectionLead: Name and slug for billing portals and URLs. Guest play cap applies to venues that inherit from this org.
organizationDetail.guestCapHint: Venues inherit this when their own cap is unset. Env fallback applies after org default. Stored as
organizationDetail.venuesLead: Check venues to attach or detach from this organization. Open a venue row in CMS for content and geofence.
organizationDetail.newVenueLead: Enter a display name, then set the map pin and draw the play area. Guests only count as in venue when they are inside that polygon.
organizationDetail.playAreaDefinedHint: You can continue to adjust the shape, then use Create & link below.
organizationDetail.playAreaNotDrawnHint: Use Draw polygon in the map toolbar and close the ring so the pin sits inside.
organizationDetail.addressLegendHint: Shown on venue listings; does not affect the geofence.
organizationDetail.createVenueLead: Draw a geofence on the map before confirming — the venue is created and linked in one step.
organizationDetail.geofenceRequiredBody: Draw a play-area polygon on the map before creating this venue.
organizationDetail.countryHint: Stored as ISO code (e.g. BA) for listings.
organizationDetail.applyLinkHint: Tick venues above, then confirm to attach or detach them from this organization.
organizationDetail.saveConfirmReturn: You will return to the organizations list after saving.
organizationDetail.errGuestCap: Guest daily game cap must be empty or an integer 1–999.
organizationDetail.deleteConfirmBody: "{{name}}" will be removed. Venues stay in the system but are unlinked from this org. This cannot be undone.
organizationDetail.linkConfirmLead: Confirm attaching and detaching venues for this organization. Venues linked from another org are moved here.
organizationDetail.linkConfirmMoveWarning: Some venues are currently tied to another organization and will be moved to this one.
organizationDetail.createConfirmGeofence: Geofence: {{count}} positions in outer ring (including closing point).

welcome_back.label: Welcome back (soft)
welcome_back.name: Welcome back — soft nudge
welcome_back.title: We'd love to see you again
welcome_back.body: You've played at our place before — stop by this week for a drink and a quick round in Cafe Social.

happy_hour.label: Happy hour / offer
happy_hour.name: Happy hour reminder
happy_hour.title: Something's on today
happy_hour.body: We've got a little extra on today — open the app at the venue to see the featured offer and your perks.

daily_word.label: Daily ritual
daily_word.name: Daily word ritual
daily_word.title: Today's word is live
daily_word.body: Open Cafe Social at the venue and try the daily word — quick, friendly, and on us.

friends_table.label: Play with friends
friends_table.name: Bring a friend
friends_table.title: Grab a table, start a room
friends_table.body: Host a word match from the app and share the room code — perfect for a slow afternoon.
